title: SmartArt-like drawing pptx 001
notes: python-pptx cannot emit diagrams: raw p:graphicFrame elements with wps:wsp shapes (rect + ellipse, wps:txbx/w:txbxContent text, same wps layout the docx builder uses) appended to the slide spTree via parse_xml — the pptx-scale mirror of docx smartart-drawing 001. LibreOffice renders shape txbx text into the PDF text layer, so the labels are reference text. DrawingML shapes only — no diagram parts, not MS-generated SmartArt.
